subject: Post-demo: model fit next steps, benchmark links, and stabilization plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + recommended eval plan (models, prompts, next steps)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a focused eval running: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce hallucination rate on billing & eligibility responses for the claims assistant flow while keeping latency under 400ms P95.
- Target workload: medium-length dialog turns (avg 90 tokens), mix of customer questions + policy lookups.
- Success signal: precision on factual fields (provider name, claim amount, service date) + qualitative HITL review pass rate.

Recommended starting models (for eval)
- redwood-7b-instruct-v2026-08-31 (quantized q4f) — baseline that matched your latency envelope in the call.
- llama3-70b-q4f (instruct-tuned) — higher quality candidate, higher cost; check SLOs for P95 latency.
- redwood-3b-high-precise (experimental prompts tuning) — low-cost guardrail tier.

Artifacts attached / linked
- optima_eval_prompts.md (prompt set & variants we discussed) [attached]
- benchmark_summary_20260907.csv (sample run from the demo corpus) [attached]
- Drive folder with full run logs: https://drive.redwood/optima/benchmarks/20260907

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the eval dataset we should run on (anonymized sample or full dev set)? Reply with a link or confirm our attached sample.
2) I'll provision an eval pack and schedule a batch diff run between redwood-7b-instruct-v2026-08-31 and the current deployed variant. Expect initial results within 48 hours of dataset confirmation.
3) If we see a clear regression we can either: (a) pin your route to the older variant (fastest), or (b) apply targeted prompt fixes + small prompt scoring blacklist (slightly longer). We recommend pinning for production-critical flows.

I'll start the eval prep on our side — Marissa will own the prompt tuning handoff and Rishi will coordinate SLOs/rollback if needed.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0112

Attachments: optima_eval_prompts.md, benchmark_summary_20260907.csv
From: Samantha Green <samantha@optimahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: evaluation_team@optimahealth.com
Date: 2026-09-08T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + recommended eval plan (models, prompts, next steps)

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. Two quick data points from our side: 

- We confirmed the anonymized dev set (link sent to your team via GDrive invite). Please use that for the initial diff.
- We noticed a spike in hallucination-like responses after a model version update last week (samples attached: example_hallucination_examples.txt). Those were surfaced in the billing assistant flow — the model invented reimbursement timelines and incorrect provider IDs.

Question: can you confirm whether the redwood-7b-instruct variant we saw on your demo is the pre-update build? If the regression is confirmed we need a short-term stabilization (pin/rollback) before we expand the trial. Production impact is moderate (customer confusion, tickets rising).

Also: do you have a rough ETA for the diff and a recommended rollback window (how long to keep the old variant pinned while we do remediation)?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Samantha
Samantha Green
Senior Product Manager, Claims Automation | OptimaHealth
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + recommended eval plan (models, prompts, next steps)

On Tue, Sep 8, 2026 at 8:33 AM Samantha Green <samantha@optimahealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. Two quick data points from our side: 
> 
> - We confirmed the anonymized dev set (link sent to your team via GDrive invite). Please use that for the initial diff.
> - We noticed a spike in hallucination-like responses after a model version update last week (samples attached: example_hallucination_examples.txt). Those were surfaced in the billing assistant flow — the model invented reimbursement timelines and incorrect provider IDs.
> 
> Question: can you confirm whether the redwood-7b-instruct variant we saw on your demo is the pre-update build? If the regression is confirmed we need a short-term stabilization (pin/rollback) before we expand the trial. Production impact is moderate (customer confusion, tickets rising).

Thanks for the dataset access — we have the files and will kick off the diff. Quick answers: 
- The version we recommended in the recap (redwood-7b-instruct-v2026-08-31) is the pre-update baseline we validated in the demo. The build you are seeing in production looks like a newer patch that slipped into your route (we're investigating routing logs).
- Plan & ETA: we will run a token-level and soft-metric diff between v2026-08-31 and the currently-deployed variant. Initial batch run complete in ~24 hours; full evaluation (including prompt-ablation checks) in 48 hours.
- Recommended short-term stabilization: pin to redwood-7b-instruct-v2026-08-31 for 72 hours while we triage. That gives us a deterministic window to validate prompt fixes and run a red-team pass on the flagged examples.

Proposed immediate actions (I will start these today):
1) Run batch diff on the linked dev set. Results -> drive link and a short CSV summary (benchmark_summary_20260907.csv) once done.
2) Create an eval-pack (eval-pack-v1.zip) with flagged prompts + scoring rubric and share with your team for HITL review.
3) If the regression meets the gating threshold you gave (>= 8% increase in hallucination-related failures), we will schedule a staged pin on your route. Staged pin: route split 90/10 (old/new) for 1 hour, then 100% pin. This preserves telemetry and lets us confirm no regressions in other metrics.

Marissa — can you take the prompt tuning handoff and prioritize the 12 flagged prompts? Rishi — please confirm the rollback process and an outage-free pin window on Dedicated (if Optima is on Dedicated, otherwise we will do route pin on Hosted). Laura — can you prepare the customer comms template (short note to send to ops/CS if we pin)?

I'll upload the first diff artifacts to the Drive link and circle back.

Best,
Aditya

Attachments: eval-pack-v1.zip (created, contains prompt variants and rubric)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-09T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + recommended eval plan (models, prompts, next steps)

Internal: quick coordination —

- I pulled the flagged prompts from eval-pack-v1.zip and started prompt-ablation runs locally. Preliminary note: a lightweight negative prompt + entity-confirmation step reduces hallucination tokens in our small sample. I'll post tuned prompt variants to the Drive folder later today.
- Rishi: I need the route pin runbook and confirmation on whether Optima is on Dedicated or Hosted. If Dedicated, we'll need infra to approve a maintenance window for the pin.
- Laura: I'll drop a customer-facing blurb (one-paragraph) you can send if we enact the pin. Keep it concise and apologetic while we validate.

Small ask: Aditya — tag me on the Drive results so I can attach the tuned prompts to the diff artifacts.

— Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
